[[Brechnar Ironhammer]] is the brother of [[King Jalis Ironhammer]] of the [[Deldrimor Dwarves]].

Brechnar is first seen in the [[Borlis Pass]] mission where he allows players entry into [[Grooble's Gulch]], of which he is the lord. Later he appears in the [[Thunderhead Keep]] mission where he decides to join the players on their journey into the [[Ring of Fire Islands]]. In the [[Ring of Fire]] mission, he leads a group of [[dwarf|dwarves]] creating a diversion to allow the player's party to get past the heavy [[Mursaat]] defenses at the start of the [[mission]]. Hopelessly outnumbered (and regrettably [[infusion|uninfused]]), his team is torn to pieces by the [[Mursaat]]. Following players' triumph in passing the Mursaat Fortifications, [[Vizier Khilbron]] appears and cremates his body - the party utters prayer.
